title: Galois integral-closure model for root-normalization residues
statement: theorem root_normalization_generic_stalk_galois_model {L U : Scheme.{u}} (i : U ⟶ L) (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G] (W : GaloisCover G U) (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (φ : Spec R ⟶ L) (f : R) (β : pullback i φ ≅ Scheme.Opens.toScheme (X := Spec R) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f)) (hβ : β.hom ≫ Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec R) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) = pullback.snd i φ) (H : CommRingCat.{u}) [IsNoetherianRing H] (b : R ⟶ H) (hg : IsSMulRegular H (b.hom f)) [IsDomain (H ⧸ Ideal.span {b.hom f})] : let g := b.hom f let A := AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C g) let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of A) let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap H A)) let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H A g) (∀ (Q : Ideal A) (hQ : Q.IsPrime), letI := hQ AdjoinRoot.root ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C g) ∈ Q → IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime Q)) → ∀ (hN : IsLocallyNoetherian N), letI := hN let p := pullback.snd (W.π ≫ i) (V.ι ≫ q ≫ Spec.map b ≫ φ) ∀ (hp : IsFinite p), letI := hp let a := p ≫ V.ι Etale p → IsFinite a.fromNormalization → ∀ (D : Scheme.{u}) (j : D ⟶ N), IsRegular D → IsIntegral D → IsEffectiveCartierCenter j → (∀ z : N, z ∈ V ↔ z ∉ Set.range j) → ∀ (η : D), IsGenericPoint η Set.univ → ∀ (x : a.normalization), a.fromNormalization x = j η → ∃ (S : CommRingCat.{u}) (T : Subgroup G) (alg : Algebra (N.presheaf.stalk (j η)) S), letI := alg ∃ (act : MulSemiringAction T S), letI := act IsDomain (N.presheaf.stalk (j η)) ∧ IsDomain S ∧ Module.Finite (N.presheaf.stalk (j η)) S ∧ Module.Flat (N.presheaf.stalk (j η)) S ∧ IsGaloisGroup T (N.presheaf.stalk (j η)) S ∧ ∃ (q₀ : Ideal S), q₀.IsPrime ∧ (letI := (a.fromNormalization.residueFieldMap x).hom.toAlgebra Module.finrank (N.residueField (a.fromNormalization x)) (a.normalization.residueField x)) = q₀.inertiaDeg (N.presheaf.stalk (j η))

proof.text: The monic quotient A is free over H, so g and t are regular. A/(t)=H/(g) is a domain; (t) has height one by the principal ideal theorem and is not minimal. Its regular localization is a DVR. The support of the integral Cartier centre is V(t), identifying j(eta) with (t).

Compatibility of beta identifies the generic fibre of p with a G-torsor. Select the connected field factor determined by the generization of x and its stabilizer subgroup T of G. T acts faithfully with fixed fraction field K, so the factor is a finite Galois extension.

Integral closure commutes with localization. Identify the relative normalization over the DVR stalk with the product of integral closures in its generic field factors. Let S be the factor containing x; finiteness of normalization makes S module finite over the stalk. S is a domain and torsion free, hence flat over the DVR. The stabilizer action preserves S and its invariants are the DVR (normality). Thus IsGaloisGroup T R0 S holds.

The point x corresponds to a prime q of S. The stalk and integral-closure comparisons preserve the canonical residue maps, so the two residue extensions are isomorphic over isomorphic base fields. Their finranks agree. No arithmetic degree formula or divisibility statement is used.
